items.title: FMCG revenues to rise in Q2, but costs could dent margins
items.description: India's FMCG sector is poised for a substantial revenue boost in the upcoming September quarter, with growth projected in double digits. This rise is attributed to an increase in both product volume and strategic pricing tactics across diverse categories. However, the ongoing surge in raw material costs, particularly for items like sugar and edible oils, may exert pressure on profit margins.

items.title: ICICI Prudential AMC Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 889 crore; co declares Rs 30/share dividend
items.description: ICICI Prudential AMC reported a 6.1% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 889 crore, while revenue from operations grew 16.3% to Rs 1,674 crore. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs 30 per share, with October 21, 2026, set as the record date. Its quarterly average AUM rose 14.4% to Rs 11.61 lakh crore.

items.title: HCL Tech dividend alert! IT major declares Rs 12 interim dividend for FY27; Q2 profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 5,132 crore
items.description: HCLTech has declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share for FY27, with October 16 set as the record date and October 26 as the payment date. The IT major reported a 21% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 5,132 crore and announced a global partnership with Anthropic.

items.title: HCL Tech Q2 Results: Profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 5,132 crore; co declares Rs 12/share dividend
items.description: HCL Tech Q2 Results: HCL Tech reported a 21% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,132 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 35,620 crore. The IT major declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, retained its FY27 margin guidance and reported strong AI revenue growth and deal wins.
